name: IVR
tagline: International Association for Inland Waterway Transport in Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: L'IVR a organisé son congrès annuel en mai 2024 avec 225 participants provenant de 11 pays différents, démontrant une forte mobilisation des acteurs européens du transport fluvial et confirmant son rôle central d'association indépendante et neutre dans le secteur.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the IVR annual congress held in Frankfurt am Main, May 15-17, 2024
kpis.description: The 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 different countries, representing shipping industry, insurance, and ship survey sectors.

kpis.explanation: Number of different European countries represented by participants at the 2024 annual congress
kpis.description: The 2024 congress brought together representatives from 11 different European countries, demonstrating IVR's pan-European scope and influence.

kpis.name_fr: Participants au Colloque de Prévention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024
kpis.description: The first-ever Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, attracted approximately 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in inland navigation.

kpis.name_fr: Réunions du Comité de Prévention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of physical meetings held by the Loss Prevention Committee in 2024
kpis.description: The Loss Prevention Committee held three in-person meetings during 2024 to address technical regulations and prevention challenges in inland navigation.

ai_positioning.summary: No information about artificial intelligence positioning or strategy is available in the 2024 Annual Report provided.
